fieldNotes.truckGate: Fenced truck yard south of the building; gated driveway off the internal loop road with chain-link fence and a row of bollards/posts across the lane (2023-07 Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance in any Street View heading (2019 & 2023 panos). Gate controlled by fence/bollards only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard booth -> implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~9-10 dock doors on the south building face; several trailers backed in (z20 satellite).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Fenced dock apron holds parked trailers; estimated 10-25 stalls of yard space but not a dedicated standalone drop lot.
fieldNotes.dropYard: The adjacent colorful-trailer lot to the south is a SEPARATE trucking/cross-dock facility (own building), NOT Pactiv. Pactiv's own trailer parking is the fenced dock apron only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide single-point gate apron with generous unused paved width; room to add a bypass lane. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the east property edge but no spur enters the Pactiv building; the large intermodal terminal is the Norfolk Southern yard west of Westbelt Dr, unrelated.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved apron between the gate and the south dock doors easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
